info.title: Financial Datasets API — Analyst Estimates
info.description: Consensus Wall Street analyst estimates (estimated revenue + estimated earnings per share) for US stock tickers, broken down by fiscal period (annual or quarterly). Proxied through AIsa from the Financial Datasets API.

fiscal_period.description: The fiscal period of the analyst estimate.

period.description: The period of the analyst estimate.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote for the exact request. No Provider call, billing reservation, durable job, or price lock is created.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always USD in this version.

estimate_kind.description: `exact` is a fully determined customer price; `upper_bound` has a locally enforceable ceiling in `max_cost_micros_usd`; `estimate` depends on terminal usage and may exceed the quoted amount.

estimated_cost_micros_usd.description: Quoted customer cost in micro-USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros).

max_cost_micros_usd.description: Optional hard customer-cost ceiling in micro-USD. Present for `exact` and `upper_bound`; omitted for `estimate`.

pricing_version.description: Optional immutable or compiled pricing version.

estimated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was produced.

metadata.description: Bounded non-sensitive quote metadata, such as a canonical model or profile key.

NotFoundError.description: The specified resource was not found

PaymentRequiredError.description: The request requires a paid subscription

example.message: This endpoint requires a paid subscription. Please upgrade your plan.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote. The intended request is validated but not executed, billed, reserved, or locked.

Cache-Control.description: Quotes are never stored by shared caches.

Vary.description: Response body depends on the cost-mode header.

XAISACostMode.name: X-AISA-Cost-Mode
XAISACostMode.description: Set to `quote` to estimate this exact request without executing data, creating a job, or authorizing spend. A successful quote is HTTP 200 with a `cost_estimate` body; it is not a reservation or price lock. Omit the header for normal execution. Any other value returns `400 invalid_cost_mode`. Quote mode requires an API key and cannot use MPP or x402.

get.description: Forward analyst consensus for one stock: `fiscal_period`, `period`, `revenue` and `earnings_per_share` per estimated period. `ticker` is required; `period` selects annual or quarterly and `limit` caps how many periods come back. Deliberately narrow — no analyst names, no ratings, no price targets, no high/low dispersion. Use it for what the street expects. For what was actually reported, and by how much it beat or missed, use `get_financial_earnings`.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: The ticker to get analyst estimates for.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to get analyst estimates for. Use the /analyst-estimates/periods endpoint to get a list of available periods. Defaults to 'annual'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of estimates to return (max 3 for annual, 12 for quarterly).

200.description: Analyst estimates response. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.
